acceptance: Every manifest-declared deployment mode is selectable via `platform:mode` and recorded as platform.deployment.selected in the bundle (test per platform via the adapter factory)
Cloud and self-hosted runs of the same platform get distinct variant ids
Deployment alias keys derive from the manifest; no hand-written parallel list
context: Found by the 2026-10-13 adversarial review of the core execution-variants batch (compute O1/O6). Not covered by its remediation; verified on develop 9400b62c4. ADR: docs/development/adr/adr-core-execution-variants.md (deployment and identity decisions).
description:
## Problem
- **Modes are declared but never recorded.** TimescaleDB, SingleStore and Databend declare cloud and self-hosted deployment modes in the manifest, but never set `deployment_selected` (base None at `platforms/base/adapter.py:119-120`, read at `runtime_metadata.py:85`).
  - Their cloud and self-hosted runs therefore share one variant id.
  - TimescaleDB `from_config` drops `deployment_mode` (`platforms/timescaledb.py:90-95,98-99`), and `timescaledb:cloud` is rejected.
- **Deployment aliases live in a second registry.** `DEPLOYMENT_ALIAS_KEYS` (`core/deployment.py:11-21`) is a hand-written list beside the manifest, which is why TimescaleDB is missing from it.
  - It overlaps `DEPRECATED_OPTION_ALIASES` (`core/execution_engine.py:37-40`) for clickhouse/mode and influxdb/mode.
  - The manifest compute native keys (`core/compute_resource.py:61`) are a third place.

## Change
- Pass `deployment_mode` through `TimescaleDBAdapter.from_config`.
- Register the three platforms with the selector and set `deployment_selected` and `deployment_selected_class`, or remove modes that cannot be selected from the manifest.
- Derive the deployment alias keys from the manifest `deployment_modes`, keep one alias table, and replace the literal-set test with a manifest check.
